clips.title: The story
paras: Brock Stoneseeker teaches mining in Thelsamar, in Loch Modan. At Brock's School of Mining and Surveying, he trains novice prospectors to extract ores and minerals.

In Thelsamar, Brock Stoneseeker teaches miners at Brock's School of Mining and Surveying. Loch Modan's hills hold rich mineral veins, and miners need skill with a pickaxe and an eye for the rock. Brock teaches the basics of finding ore, extracting raw metals, and surveying underground deposits. His lessons help Alliance tradesfolk supply Ironforge's smithies.
